predicate.label: fielded or used an athlete in play
predicate.definition: Team, coach, or manager X fields or uses athlete Y in sporting play.
includes: explicit playing or fielding of an individual athlete by a team or coach
historical use of the athlete in play
excludes: playing against an opposing team or competitor
mere player membership without X selecting or using the athlete
ambiguous: generic removal without a clear sporting selection context
play whose athlete-versus-opponent role is unresolved
prospective selection or materially incomplete action roles
predicate.notes: The subject can be the coach rather than the team. Bare play is polysemous; inspect both arguments and all local evidence. Removing an athlete does not by itself establish that X fielded the athlete.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit playing or fielding of an individual athlete by a team or coach; historical use of the athlete in play. Excludes: playing against an opposing team or competitor; mere player membership without X selecting or using the athlete; ordinary employment or political candidacy. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic removal without a clear sporting selection context; play whose athlete-versus-opponent role is unresolved; prospective selection or materially incomplete action roles. The subject can be the coach rather than the team. Bare play is polysemous; inspect both arguments and all local evidence. Removing an athlete does not by itself establish that X fielded the athlete.

rationale: Full literal role inspection separates three opposing-team play rows from two coach-to-player play rows. The latter plus three coach removal rows form a narrow sporting-selection family; removal alone is not sufficient to grade fielding as supported. Independently reviewed by Boyle; unrelated candidate/office roles excluded.
